about.support.title: Made with care
about.support.body: I build and maintain this in my spare time. If it has helped you, a Patreon membership lets me keep improving it. No pressure, and thank you for being here.
about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Zone, mark, and bill names always follow the game client.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the run while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside. Your bills and session stats are kept.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto Hunt Grinder window. /ahg config | stats | deps | about | pause (pause or resume the run) | target (dump current target's BaseId).
progress.tooltip.noSpawnData: {0} has no known spawn points, so the run leaves it to you.
safety.cat.repairSub: Auto-repair gear when equipped item condition drops below the threshold.
safety.cat.consumablesSub: Keep food and medicine buffs up while hunting: Well Fed is a free +3% EXP.
safety.cat.humanizerSub: Take periodic city breaks between marks: teleport to a random hub and wander around for a few minutes before resuming.
safety.cat.partyInvitesSub: Auto-decline incoming party invites during a run, after a human-like delay, with an optional reply.
safety.cat.gmAlertSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the bot, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.repair.autoRepairHelp: Between marks, when the lowest equipped item drops to or below the threshold, the plugin runs a repair. At 0% the gear stops working, so keep some margin.
safety.repair.autoRepairOff: Auto-repair is off. Enable it to configure repair.
safety.repair.thresholdHelp: Trips when the worst equipped slot reaches this condition percentage. 20% leaves comfortable margin before the 0% breakdown.
safety.repair.sourceHelp: How the repair is performed. Self-repair uses Dark Matter from your bag (no travel). NPC repair travels to your Grand Company mender.
safety.repair.selfThenNpc.name: Self, then NPC
safety.repair.selfThenNpc.detail: Use Dark Matter from your bag first; fall back to the Grand Company mender when you run out.
safety.repair.selfOnly.name: Self only
safety.repair.selfOnly.detail: Repair with Dark Matter from your bag. No travel.
safety.repair.npcOnly.name: NPC only
safety.repair.npcOnly.detail: Travel to your Grand Company mender (or a custom NPC) and repair there.
safety.repair.customNpcHelp: Optional. Travel to any repair NPC instead of the Grand Company mender. Target the NPC in-game, then click "Set from target". Clear to fall back to the GC mender.
safety.repair.npcNote: NPC repair uses your custom repair NPC if set, otherwise your Grand Company mender, teleporting there when needed. A custom NPC removes the Grand Company requirement.
safety.repair.noTargetChat: No target - target a repair NPC first, then click again.
safety.consumables.autoConsumeHelp: Use food and medicine between marks to keep their buffs up; Well Fed alone is a free +3% EXP. Items are consumed only when out of combat, and refreshed before the buff runs out.
safety.consumables.autoConsumeOff: Auto-consume is off. Enable it to pick items.
safety.consumables.refreshUnderHelp: Re-consume once the buff has fewer than this many minutes left. 0 only re-applies after it fully wears off. A meal lasts 30 minutes.
safety.consumables.addItemHelp: Pick from the food and medicine in your bag. HQ is used automatically when you have it.
safety.consumables.activeItemsHelp: Each is kept active in order; the next available one is consumed if the first runs out.
safety.consumables.noneInBag: No food or medicine in your bag. Stock some, then add it here.
safety.consumables.noItemsAdded: No items added - nothing will be consumed.
safety.humanizer.enableHelp: Every N marks, teleport to a random selected city and wander around for a few minutes before resuming. Helps you avoid player reports by acting a little more human, useful when you leave the PC running for long sessions and don't want others noticing you hunting non-stop.
safety.humanizer.off: Humanizer is off. Enable it to configure breaks.
safety.humanizer.marksBetweenHelp: Take a break after this many mark kills. The count starts over after each break, and whenever a run starts or resumes.
safety.humanizer.breakLengthHelp: A random duration between these two values is rolled for each break.
safety.humanizer.pauseBetweenHelp: After arriving at each random point, stand still for a random duration in this range before walking somewhere else.
safety.humanizer.walkDistanceHelp: Each random destination is rolled this many meters away from your current position. Larger ranges cover more of the city; smaller ranges keep you near the aetheryte.
safety.humanizer.allowedCitiesHelp: Tick the cities the plugin is allowed to teleport to. One is picked at random each break. Untick cities you haven't unlocked or don't want visited.
safety.humanizer.noCities: No cities selected - Humanizer will skip the break and keep hunting.
safety.invites.autoDeclineHelp: While a hunt is running, automatically decline incoming party invites after a short random delay. Invites that arrive while idle or playing manually are left alone for you to handle.
safety.invites.autoDeclineOff: Auto-decline is off. Enable it to configure it.
safety.invites.delayHelp: Wait a random time in this range before declining, so it looks like you noticed the popup and dismissed it yourself.
safety.invites.sendReplyHelp: After declining, send a chat message so it reads like a polite human brush-off rather than an instant silent decline.
safety.invites.channelHelp: Where the message goes. "Tell inviter" whispers the person who invited you. Ignored when your message starts with a slash command.
safety.invites.channelTell.name: Tell inviter
safety.invites.channelTell.detail: Whisper the person who invited you.
safety.invites.channelSay.name: Say
safety.invites.channelSay.detail: Local /say, heard by players near you.
safety.invites.channelYell.name: Yell
safety.invites.messageHelp: Use {name} for the inviter's character name and {world} for their home world. If the message begins with "/", it's sent verbatim as a command (e.g. /tell {name}@{world} busy right now!).
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: Halt automation immediately when a GM appears nearby. Strongly recommended; the rest of the alerts are useless if the bot keeps hunting.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
safety.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
safety.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
session.autoResumeHelp: If the hunt hits an unexpected error and stops, restart it automatically (up to 3 times in 5 minutes) instead of ending the run. Turn it off if you would rather have faults end the run.
